findings.detail: INVENTED FIXTURE - the ladder puts 0.25 on the custody-unwind case. Nothing in the record sets that number, and the bench's own five answers ranged from 0.15 to 0.40 on it. Say plainly that it is judgment.
findings.title: The downside odds are asserted, not derived

findings.detail: INVENTED FIXTURE - every recorded recovery took 25 months or more, and the ladder prices twelve. The bull rung is therefore the least supported rung on the page.
findings.title: The horizon does the work

summary: INVENTED FIXTURE - The evidence standard here is unusually high and the arithmetic is shown, which is rare. My reserve is that the probabilities carry the whole rating and the record cannot settle them; the document says so, which is the honest answer, but a reader should understand that the rating moves with a judgment rather than with a measurement.
